products.title: Classic Vegan Long Boots 'in Love with… Pink' - Limited edition by Saraisinlovewith...
products.body_html:
A love letter you can wear.
Created by the artist and designer Saraisinlovewith…, this limited-edition long boot brings her signature heart boldly in front. Just where we all should have it 💖. 

Why you’ll love them
• Heart in front – a symbol of openness, joy, and brave self-expression.
• Vegan & premium – soft, warm lining and our signature lightweight sole.
• Limited edition – crafted in a small drop to celebrate Sara’s birthday.
• Designed for play – bold, fun, unapologetically pink.

Materials & details
• 100% vegan and recycled materials
• Lightweight, cushioned sole
• Extended long-boot silhouette
• Heart patch placed front–centre
• Colour: Saraisinlove Pink

The story behind the design
Sara believes in wearing your emotions loudly, lovingly, boldly.
We believe in thoughtful design and ethical craftsmanship.
This collaboration is where both worlds meet – joy meets intention.
Available in limited drop only, till stock lasts…

products.title: Lumberjack Recycled Beanie Navy
products.body_html:
Sharp-looking. Warm. Functional. And fully made from recycled yarn sourced from pet bottles, collected – as legend would have it – from the actual lumberjacks. Like all modern lumberjacks, it is unisex.
